selected_problem: Fresh canonical main already fails closed when a durable mission document id no longer matches its storage id, but AutonomousMissionStore.update could itself rewrite id and persist a document that the same store rejects on its next read.（最新规范主仓已经会在持久化 mission 文档 id 与存储 id 不一致时失败关闭，但 AutonomousMissionStore.update 自身仍能改写 id，并持久化一个下一次读取时会被同一存储拒绝的文档。）
selection_basis: This closes a direct write-side contradiction against the already-established durable mission-id read boundary.（这是对已经建立的持久化 mission ID 读取边界的直接写入侧矛盾闭合。）
RunStore already enforces the same invariant that its public update API cannot create an identity mismatch its own read path rejects.（RunStore 已经执行相同不变量：公开 update API 不能制造自身读取路径会拒绝的身份不匹配。）

pre_fix_reality.focused_replay: 1/2 PASS, 1/2 FAIL（1/2 通过，1/2 失败）
pre_fix_reality.failure: update accepted a different id and durably produced a mission document whose body id no longer matched its storage filename.（update 接受不同 id，并持久化生成正文 id 与存储文件名不再匹配的 mission 文档。）

changes: Reject update patches that change mission id away from the durable identity with MISSION_ID_IMMUTABLE.（以 MISSION_ID_IMMUTABLE 拒绝把 mission id 改离持久化身份的更新补丁。）
Allow an explicitly repeated same id so compatibility with identity-preserving patches remains unchanged.（允许显式重复同一 id，保持身份不变补丁的兼容性。）

verification.focused_store_replay: 2/2 PASS, 0 skipped（2/2 通过，0 跳过）
verification.pre_fix_replay: 1/2 PASS, 1/2 FAIL as expected（修复前按预期 1/2 通过、1/2 失败）
verification.hosted_runtime: Developer Execution Runtime remains unavailable with transient HTTP 502, so no hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed.（Developer Execution Runtime 仍因暂时性 HTTP 502 不可用，因此不声称托管 DWAC 已成功执行。）

truth_boundary: This cycle protects update-side durable mission id immutability only. It does not yet claim complete mission status/shape/ledger enforcement or authenticated-artifact protection against coordinated rewrites.（本轮只保护更新侧持久化 mission ID 不可变性；尚不声称完整执行 mission 状态/结构/账本约束，也不声称抵御协调一致重写下的认证工件问题。）
